description: GPT-6.2 Sol is OpenAI's reasoning model for text, images, and tool use. It accepts text and images, generates text, and supports a 1,050,000-token context window with up to 128,000 output tokens. Structured outputs, prompt caching, and Responses API tools such as web search and computer use support multi-step workflows.
name: OpenAI: GPT-6.2 Sol (Fast)
